categories.main_business_segments: Texas Roadhouse, Inc. operates three primary restaurant concepts: Texas Roadhouse (moderately priced, full-service, casual dining focused on steaks and American fare), Bubba’s 33 (family-friendly sports bar and grill with burgers, pizza, and wings), and Jaggers (fast-casual burgers and chicken). The company also has a retail initiatives segment, including an online store and royalty-based licensing arrangements. Texas Roadhouse and Bubba’s 33 are the reportable segments, with Jaggers and retail initiatives grouped under 'Other.'
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes freshly prepared, high-quality food using proprietary recipes for consistency and taste. Steaks are hand-cut daily on-premises, and side items and rolls are made from scratch in each restaurant. Food safety is prioritized through rigorous training, daily taste and temperature checks, and regular audits. Digital enhancements include online waitlists, to-go ordering, contactless payments, and robust POS and management information systems.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Texas Roadhouse targets a broad segment of value-conscious consumers seeking high-quality, affordable meals in a casual, family-friendly environment. Bubba’s 33 appeals to families and sports fans, while Jaggers serves fast-casual diners. The company serves both dine-in and to-go customers, with a focus on repeat local guests and community engagement.
categories.geographic_coverage: As of December 27, 2022, Texas Roadhouse, Inc. operated 697 restaurants (597 company-owned and 100 franchised) across 49 U.S. states and ten foreign countries. The majority of locations are in the U.S., with significant concentrations in Texas and Florida, and international franchise locations in countries such as South Korea, Philippines, Saudi Arabia, and the UAE.
categories.supply_chain_position: Texas Roadhouse operates at the downstream end of the supply chain as a restaurant operator and franchisor, serving end consumers. The company procures food and supplies directly from suppliers and distributors, focusing on quality and competitive pricing, but does not engage in upstream food production or processing.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding the restaurant base domestically and internationally, acquiring franchise locations, maintaining/improving restaurant-level profitability, and leveraging scalable infrastructure. R&D efforts focus on menu innovation, digital guest experience enhancements, operational efficiency, and new concept development (e.g., Jaggers). The company also invests in training, technology upgrades, and localized marketing.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily from restaurant food and beverage sales at company-owned locations. Additional revenue streams include franchise royalties and fees, retail product sales, and management services provided to certain franchisees. Alcoholic beverages account for about 11% of restaurant sales.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Texas Roadhouse competes in the highly competitive casual dining segment against national and regional chains (e.g., Outback Steakhouse, LongHorn Steakhouse, Chili’s), independent restaurants, fast-casual and quick-service chains, and meal kit/grocery alternatives. The company positions itself as a value leader with a focus on quality, service, and a differentiated guest experience.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In fiscal 2022, Texas Roadhouse reported total revenue of $4.0 billion, up 15.9% from the prior year, with net income of $269.8 million. The company opened 23 new company restaurants and acquired 8 franchise locations, with plans for continued expansion. Comparable restaurant sales grew 9.7%, and average unit volumes increased, reflecting strong growth and scale.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Texas Roadhouse emphasizes 'Legendary Food, Legendary Service,' offering freshly prepared, high-quality meals at attractive price points in a fun, local, and family-friendly atmosphere. Differentiators include hand-cut steaks, made-from-scratch sides, attentive service, performance-based manager compensation, and a strong community/local marketing focus. The company’s operational consistency and guest experience are key to its competitive advantage.
